title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 16, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.5 (Peaked November 15, 2026 at 21:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 320 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

We're looking pretty quiet right now. 🌎

Several bright active regions and small sunspot groups are visible today, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
